identity.name: Elijah Ndeto
identity.headline: Senior Data Engineer
identity.tagline: I design and run the data platforms behind real-time decisions, from ingestion to recovery.

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years designing, migrating and running data platforms across cloud and on-premise environments. Currently own near real-time BI streaming infrastructure on GCP at Sportserve, from ingestion to recovery. Previously architected an enterprise warehouse across 20+ source systems, moved 15+ systems to Snowflake, and led an on-premise to Databricks and Snowflake lakehouse migration. Known for taking end-to-end ownership of reliability, governance and data quality, and for translating between BI, warehouse and engineering teams.

experience.role: Senior Data Engineer – BI Streaming Platform
bullets: Took ownership of the CRM activation platform through handover and stood up its pre-production environment across six markets (LATAM, India, Japan, Rest of Asia, Rest of World and a brand market): Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Eventarc, Firestore, GCS and APIs, with CI/CD for Cloud Run services.

Built and shipped server-side tracking that streams successful-deposit events from the payments pipeline to GA4 via Google Tag Manager, with player-level user IDs, a currency dimension and success and failure logging in BigQuery.

Delivered a server-side GTM marketing-campaign integration from investigation to production in about five weeks; now extending it to near real-time first-time-deposit tracking and handing knowledge over to the team.

Designed and deployed a Firestore-to-BigQuery backfill solution to recover missing records, and hardened production pipelines through runtime upgrades, duplicate removal, scheduler fixes and a documented review of game-provider Cloud Functions.
Partnered with business analysts on payments intelligence: built BigQuery tables and monitoring views for affiliate statistics, bank-transaction matching and payment-provider reconciliation.
Designed and implemented scalable data pipelines and integration frameworks across multiple enterprise data sources.
Led transition from on-premise data solutions to cloud-based architectures, leveraging Databricks and Snowflake.
Built and optimised data ingestion and transformation pipelines within a lakehouse architecture (Medallion: Bronze → Silver → Gold).
Developed feature engineering workflows using PySpark to support predictive analytics models (XGBoost, Random Forest, TFT).
Applied DevOps practices, Unity Catalog governance, YAML scheduling, and modular Python wheel-based pipeline design.
Designed and governed enterprise data architecture and integration frameworks across 20+ source systems.
Implemented multi-layered data architecture: raw ingestion → integration → Data Vault → dimensional modelling → reporting layers.
Established data quality and validation frameworks, improving accuracy and trust in reporting datasets.
Applied MDM strategies, PII/PHI masking, RBAC, indexing, and partitioning for governance, security, and performance.
Collaborated with architects, SMEs, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into logical and physical data models.
Integrated 10+ source systems into a Common Information Model (CIM) for consistent and unified reporting.
Conducted reverse engineering of 40+ schemas and supported migration of 15+ source systems to Snowflake EDW.
Designed dimensional data models (facts and dimensions) and developed source-to-target mapping frameworks.
Ensured data accuracy and compliance through auditing, validation, and analytical reporting processes.
Delivered analytical insights to support operational decision-making; maintained high standards of data quality and reporting integrity.
Provided technical support, software maintenance and troubleshooting for business clients.
Set up networking and infrastructure, including CCTV and connectivity solutions.
Supported website development, technical documentation and software rollouts.
